usedFor: Deepgram turns speech into text with “Transcribe Audio to Plain Text” and text into audio with “Convert Text to Speech”.

bestTemplate.name: “Transcribe Audio to Plain Text” in Deepgram
bestTemplate.why: It takes an audio or video file from a URL and returns the plain text transcript.

watchOut: “Transcribe Audio to Plain Text” works from a file URL, so the recording needs a reachable link.
